labels: A volleyball player bends both knees and joins the forearms into a flat receiving platform below a descending ball, with feet spread on the court.; 배구 선수가 양 무릎을 굽히고 내려오는 공 아래에서 두 아래팔을 평평한 받침으로 모으며 두 발을 코트 위에 벌린다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: A volleyball player bends both knees and joins the forearms into a flat receiving platform below a descending ball, with feet spread on the court.
aliases: 공 받기 준비
